title: STRIKE ADDENDUM: PROVENANCE STABILITY CONDITION
creator: Lee Sharks
description:
A governance addendum by Lee Sharks clarifying the terms of the January 2026 Semantic Economy strike notice after a source-reported Google AI Overview disappearance and reappearance event.

The document defines the **Provenance Stability Condition**: attribution, diagnostic vocabulary, and framework visibility should not be silently and rapidly removed without explanation, identifiable criteria, accountability, or a stable process. It argues that volatility is more damaging than stable absence because it destroys the ability to point, teach, and rely on external retrieval. The strike remains active but conditional; withdrawal is explicitly described as not yet executed. The event chronology and multi-user/device observations are claims of the document and were not independently reproduced here.

modifications.was: On 5 January 2026, the Semantic Economy framework was observed in Google's AI Overview with full attribution to Lee Sharks. Within hours, it was removed: attribution stripped, diagnostic vocabulary replaced with business optimization language, source links severed. Within three additional hours, it returned. Multiple users, multiple devices, incognito contexts.
